title: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Protein Sequence Design and Structure-Oriented Ranking

contributions.purpose: 提出多智能体LLM蛋白序列生成架构
contributions.mechanism: 4个独立GPT-4o分段并行生成+1个polisher合并连接边界
contributions.source_quote: We propose a multi-agent LLM architecture for protein sequence generation, supporting modularity and parallelization.

contributions.purpose: 结构预测前快速筛选候选序列
contributions.mechanism: 分子量/pI/GRAVY/芳香度/不稳定指数加权启发式打分
contributions.evaluation: 92/100通过生物物理阈值,选top10送结构预测
contributions.source_quote: We define a lightweight biophysical scoring system to prioritize promising sequences before structural modeling.

contributions.purpose: 验证无进化信息的LLM序列具部分可折叠性
contributions.evaluation: 仅1条pLDDT>60(61.29)、2条pDockQ>0.5,无一达pLDDT≥70,平均PAE>28多为Very Low
contributions.source_quote: We find that several candidates demonstrate moderate foldability (e.g., mean pLDDT >60), despite no evolutionary information or functional constraints.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our method differs by employing large, general-purpose LLMs as compositional engines that can generate proteins in a flexible, user-controlled fashion.
To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to apply a multi-agent LLM architecture to protein design, incorporating biophysical analysis and AlphaFold screening in a unified pipeline.

notes: 负结果/trade-off:多数序列AlphaFold质量Very Low,无序列达pLDDT≥70,平均PAE>28。数据红旗:摘要与Discussion 6.1声称PB1FF56B0与P7BCB3768均pLDDT>60且pDockQ>0.5,但Table1显示PB1FF56B0 pDockQ仅30.58%(<0.5)、P7BCB3768 pLDDT仅48.07(<60),两条均未同时达标=过度声称/自相矛盾;Table1 pDockQ以百分比(30.58%)列而正文用0.x阈值,单位混淆。5.1节'Section ??'及checklist第4条声称的'Appendix A'为破碎/幻影交叉引用(正文无该附录)。checklist AI自披露:98% AI写作、整体97-98% AI、四类全[D]。第7条自认无统计显著性/error bar(exploratory)。
